Still stuck. The notice board at (2,7) is blocking me and I'm on its tile. This seems like a genuine trap. Let me try interacting with the notice board by facing it — but it's on my tile. 

Let me reconsider the map. The notice board 'o' — wait, in the map, (2,7) shows '@' (me), not 'o'. The 'o' blocking objects are at (7,6) [gold door] and (10,5) [workbench]. So the notice board isn't shown as 'o' on the map at (2,7). 

So why can't I move? Let me re-read the map. Row 7: `#.@P....#...#` — x=0 '#', x=1 '.', x=2 '@', x=3 'P', x=4 '.', etc. So (2,7) is me, (3,7) is player. Both walkable. I should be able to move right to (3,7) but the player is there. Let me move up to (2,6) which is '.'.
